page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i server family. It is built on the KVM hypervisor and utilizes the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance features 4 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 4 vCPUs with no hyperthreading. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This server type includes a bundled graphics processing unit, specifically one NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of total VRAM. It does not feature any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps, and the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge offers entry-level GPU acceleration combined with dedicated CPU resources, making it a resource-dense option for workloads that require hardware acceleration without the high cost of newer, larger GPU architectures. This hardware profile is suitable for workloads such as low-latency video transcoding, basic deep learning inference, small-scale AI model execution, and lightweight parallel computing tasks.
